https://example.org/nasa/great-wall-from.title: Great Wall from orbit
https://example.org/nasa/great-wall-from.text: The Great Wall is up to nine metres wide but follows the colour of the terrain. From about 400 km, astronauts report it is very difficult to see with the naked eye and was not seen without aid.

https://example.org/history/wall-myth.title: Origin of the space myth
https://example.org/history/wall-myth.text: Claims that the Wall is visible from the Moon appeared in print in the 1930s, long before any human reached orbit.

https://example.org/encyclopedia/great-w.title: Great Wall of China
https://example.org/encyclopedia/great-w.text: The Great Wall comprises walls built by several dynasties over about two thousand years.
